Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name FA & CAO Account No. 35404033198 IFSC Code SBIN0000916 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address Patny Branch, Secunderabad . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Sr.DFM/SC payable at Secunderabad . FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM/SC, South Central Railway, Secunderabad A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.

Before quoting the offer, Bidders should visit the Work site to get the idea ab out Sand loading/Attention activities & Box loading/unloading activities (i.e., S ch.1, 2, 3, 4 & 5) which are to be performed during the course of contract. 2. Bidders are allowed to quote BELOW/AT PAR/ ABOVE for the Sch.1.0 (Supply of Sand as per Specification), Sch.3.0 (loading/unloading of Train Managers B ox) & Sch.4.0 (Supply of Sand as per Specification). 3. Bidders are allowed to quote AT PAR/ABOVE only for Schedule.2.0 & Sch edule.5.0 i.e., Manpower. If Bidder quotes Negative percentage or offer s rebate/concession/discount on Man Power, then his offer shall be treat ed as nonresponsive and will not be considered and also EMD will be forfeit ed (Below % is not allowed). 4. Partnership firm: The Bidder shall submit self attested copies of (a)Registe red/ notarised partnership deed and (b) Power of attorney duly authorising one or more of the partners of the firm or any other person authorised by all the par tners to act on behalf of the firm and to submit & sign the Bid, sign the agreeme nt, witness measurements, sign measurement books, receive payment, make c orrespondences, compromise/relinquish any claim preferred by the firm, sign ‘N o claim certificate’, refer all or any dispute to arbitration and to take similar acti on in respect of all Bids/contract or said contract. The bidder shall submit above documents along with the bid, otherwise their offer will be summarily rejected. c. Company registered under companies’ act-1956: The Bidder shall subm it (a) the copies of MOA & AOA of the company and (b) power of attorney duly n otarised/registered by the company (backed by resolution of board of directors) in favour of the individual, signing the bid on behalf of the company. The bidder shall submit above documents along with the bid, otherwise their offer will be s ummarily rejected. d. Society: The Bidder shall submit the self attested copy of the certificate of r egistration, deed of formation and power of attorney in favour of the Bid signato ry. The bidder shall submit above documents along with the bid, otherwise their offer will be summarily rejected.

e. JV: Bidder shall submit all the documents as per GCC for services, otherwise their offer will be summarily rejected. 5. Earnest Money Deposit: The bidder shall be required to deposit earnest m oney (EMD) with the Bid for the due performance with the stipulation to keep the offer open till such date of validity of the offer. If bidders do not remit pro per value towards the EMD, their bidder shall be summarily rejected (Howeve r, payment of Earnest Money (EMD) will be exempted for firms registered und er MSEs, proof of document should be attached for claiming exemption). 6. The Bidder shall submit an Undertaking for Truthfulness/ Correctness of the D OCUMENTS submitted/uploaded along with the bid in the prescribed format ( as per annexure-3) for verification / confirmation of the documents submitt ed for compliance of eligibility / qualifying criteria. Note: Non submission of the undertaking or submission of undertaking either no t properly filled in, or in a format other than the prescribed format shall lead t o summary rejection of their offer. 7. The Bidder shall submit Self Declaration regarding Site visit, Banning, Bankru ptcy, Violation of labor laws, Employment/Partnership of Retired/existing Rail way Employee etc. along with the bid in the prescribed format (as per annex ure-6) Note: Non submission of the Declaration or submission of Declaration either not properly filled in, or in a format other than the prescribed format shall lead to summary rejection of their offer. 8. Along with the Bid document, Bidder shall submit documents in support of his /their claim to fulfill the eligibility criteria as mentioned in the Bid document. E ach page of the copy of the documents/certificates in support of credentials, submitted by the Bidder, shall be self attested by the Bidder or authorized repr esentative of the Biding firm. Self attestation shall include signature, stamp & date (on each page). Only those documents will be considered for evaluating b id, which are duly self-attested as above. 9. Availability of office of Service Provider: An office of the service provide r may be located in the state of consignee. Documentary evidence (Firm regi stration or GSTIN or Labour License) regarding office shall be submitted. 10. Bidder(s) are advised to note corrigendum related to the bid if any, before submission of the bid and act accordingly. .
